name: What is the difference between sheet vinyl and luxury vinyl plank for bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between sheet vinyl and luxury vinyl plank for bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sheet vinyl is a single continuous roll that provides minimal seams across small bathrooms, making it budget-friendly and quick to put down. Luxury vinyl tile or plank features thicker, rigid layers that click together or adhere as individual boards, creating a far more realistic wood or stone appearance. While sheet vinyl handles water spills well due to lack of seams, luxury vinyl is much more durable against dents and scratches, and individual damaged planks can be swapped out without replacing the entire floor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sheet vinyl offers a seamless, budget-friendly surface, whereas luxury vinyl plank provides greater durability, realistic stone or wood textures, and easier board repairs.
